DLSU ·AdRIC · CIVI

Solving Real-World Problems using Computer Vision

The Center for Computational Imaging and Visual Innovations (CIVI) specializes in research projects centered towards solving real-world problems through deep learning solutions trained on visual data. Research projects under CIVI focus on specific goals, particularly (1) data collection, (2) model building and optimization, and (3) application development.

Faculty Engagement

2024 Oct 28

Computer Vision in Agriculture

Our faculty member Dr. John Jethro Virtusio delivered a presentation entitled "Computer Vision in Agriculture" at the 10th DOST-Balik Scientist Program (BSP) Annual Convention, held in the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC).

Conference Organizer

2024 Oct 18 - 20

Machine Learning Models for Biomedical Image Classification Session

Our lab head Arren Matthew Antioquia served as session chair for Machine Learning Models for Biomedical Image Classification Session at International Conference on Biomedical Imaging and Signal Processing (ICBSP), held in Hong Kong.

Conference Presentation

2024 Oct 18 - 20

Classifying Skin Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks

Our lab head Arren Matthew Antioquia presented research on Classifying Skin Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks at International Conference on Biomedical Imaging and Signal Processing (ICBSP), held in Hong Kong.
